title: OpenFarm Slicer Provisioning Manifest
description: Maintainer-authored declaration of which (engine, version, platform) slicer builds to fetch into the application's bundled slicer directory, and the exact URL to fetch each from. Consumed only by the dev/build-time provisioning tool (tools/provision-slicers) — never read by the running application (FR-012/FR-018). The tool never derives or guesses an asset URL from a naming pattern: each engine's release asset naming can and does change between versions, so the manifest itself is the sole source of truth — copy the real link from the engine's GitHub releases page for each platform you want.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version for forward-compat; current = 2 (assets carry explicit URLs; schemaVersion 1's platforms-array + derived-filename form is no longer supported).

slicers.description: Desired set of slicers to bundle. Append-only across releases by product commitment (FR-008a) — entries are added, never removed.

platform.description: Target host platform for the fetched build (FR-009/FR-010).

version.description: Maintainer-chosen display version (FR-005) — stored/shown verbatim everywhere (bundle directory name, discovery, pickers, recorded values). It need not match the engine's literal upstream release tag; a maintainer may use a friendlier marketed string instead (e.g. "2.7.1" for a Bambu Studio build whose actual tag/asset-embedded string is "02.07.01.57"). It does need to stay a dotted-numeric shape (e.g. "2.2.0", "2.5.59.13", "01.10.00.00") for "newest" ordering to work meaningfully, and must stay stable once a build has shipped — it is not the same string used to construct download URLs, which come entirely from `assets` below. No leading 'v'.

assets.description: The exact download URL for each platform build of this (engine, version) to fetch — copied verbatim from the engine's GitHub releases page (the asset filename/naming convention is not assumed or derived by the tool, since it can change between releases). A platform omitted here is simply not provisioned for this entry (not a failure, FR-015).

notes.description: Optional free-text maintainer note (e.g. why this version is pinned).

slicers.notes: PrusaSlicer-fork CLI form — see SuperSlicerInvocation. SuperSlicer doesn't consistently publish macOS builds, so no MacOs asset here.
